rules.name: no-em-dash
rules.description: Never use em dash (—, U+2014) or en dash (–, U+2013) in any output. Use the ASCII hyphen-minus (-, U+002D) instead.

rules.name: openspec-docs-sync
rules.description: When an OpenSpec proposal is archived, update the Diataxis docs/ directory to describe the implemented change. Do not copy proposal/design content; document current component state only.

rules.name: no-run-tests
rules.description: Do not run heavy integration tests or tests that produce large output yourself; tell the user to run them and provide the exact command (or commands) from AGENTS.md, README.md, or the project's package manifests. Fast, self-contained unit tests with small output may be run as normal. Linters, formatters, and typecheckers may still be run.

rules.name: no-unrequested-changes
rules.description: Do not write code, edit files, or take system-changing actions unless the user explicitly asks. By default, respond in chat only. Reading files, searching the codebase, and answering questions are always allowed.
